"b174a7be-b08b-5e25-a86d-19769c55edd0" :question/problem "Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
\begin{aligned}x&=2 \sqrt{t} - 1\\ y&=t - 4\\ &0\le t\le 4\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "b174a7be-b08b-5e25-a86d-19769c55edd0" :question/worked-solution "First calculate the $x$-values using $x=2 \sqrt{t} - 1$:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ \hline x & -1 & 1 & -1 + 2 \sqrt{2} \\ \hline y &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 3 & 4 \\ \hline x & -1 + 2 \sqrt{3} & 3 \\ \hline y &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Now calculate $y=t - 4$ at the **same parameter values**:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ \hline x & -1 & 1 & -1 + 2 \sqrt{2} \\ \hline y & -4 & -3 & -2 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 3 & 4 \\ \hline x & -1 + 2 \sqrt{3} & 3 \\ \hline y & -1 & 0 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Pair the coordinates at the same parameter value and follow the curve only over the stated interval.

"86f12a33-46be-5f58-8bcd-bcc31de26945" :question/problem "Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$"] [:db/add "86f12a33-46be-5f58-8bcd-bcc31de26945" :question/worked-solution "First calculate the $x$-values using $x=t^{2} + 1$:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline x & 1 & 2 & 5 & 10 & 17 \\ \hline y &  &  &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 5 \\ \hline x & 26 \\ \hline y &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Now calculate $y=t \left(5 - t\right) - 1$ at the **same parameter values**:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline x & 1 & 2 & 5 & 10 & 17 \\ \hline y & -1 & 3 & 5 & 5 & 3 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 5 \\ \hline x & 26 \\ \hline y & -1 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Pair the coordinates at the same parameter value and follow the curve only over the stated interval.

"9deb93d0-b686-5a18-a81b-2b184fe640f4" :question/problem "Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

\begin{aligned}x&=t + 3\\ y&=2 t^{2} - 11\\ &-3\le t\le 3\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "9deb93d0-b686-5a18-a81b-2b184fe640f4" :question/worked-solution "First calculate the $x$-values using $x=t + 3$:

$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 2 & 3 \\ \hline x & 5 & 6 \\ \hline y &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Now calculate $y=2 t^{2} - 11$ at the **same parameter values**:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & -3 & -2 & -1 & 0 & 1 \\ \hline x & 0 & 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 \\ \hline y & 7 & -3 & -9 & -11 & -9 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & 2 & 3 \\ \hline x & 5 & 6 \\ \hline y & -3 & 7 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Pair the coordinates at the same parameter value and follow the curve only over the stated interval.

"d55cca76-de79-57f1-8227-271ebb3b8b3b" :question/problem "Determine the graph of the following parametrically defined curve:

$$
\begin{aligned}x&=- t \left(t - 2\right) - 2 t \left(t^{2} - 4\right) + 1\\ y&=t \left(t + 2\right) + t \left(t^{2} - 4\right) - 1\\ &-2\leq t\leq 2\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "d55cca76-de79-57f1-8227-271ebb3b8b3b" :question/worked-solution "First calculate the $x$-values using $x=- t \left(t - 2\right) - 2 t \left(t^{2} - 4\right) + 1$:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & -2 & -1 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ \hline x & -7 & -8 & 1 & 8 & 1 \\ \hline y &  &  &  &  &  \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

Now calculate $y=t \left(t + 2\right) + t \left(t^{2} - 4\right) - 1$ at the **same parameter values**:

$$
\begin{array}{|c|c|c|c|c|c|}\hline \mathbf{t} & -2 & -1 & 0 & 1 & 2 \\ \hline x & -7 & -8 & 1 & 8 & 1 \\ \hline y & -1 & 1 & -1 & -1 & 7 \\ \hline\end{array}
$$

The successive paired points are $(-7,-1)$, $(-8,1)$, $(1,-1)$, $(8,-1)$, $(1,7)$. Use the endpoint pair to find the matching group, then compare an interior paired point to distinguish the remaining curves.
